description: Fresh synthetic confirmation set for shorter/shared demonstrations, frozen before development scoring. 32 requests, 8 per department, 16 urgent and 16 phone requests. Same author/domain as prior sets.

department.description: Route by the main requested action: billing for charges, invoices, refunds; technical for broken product functionality or outages; account_access for login, password, or account access; sales for pre-purchase pricing or feature questions. Explicitly prioritize the main request over background context.

refund_requested.description: Does the customer explicitly ask to return or reverse money already paid? A denied, negated, hypothetical, or historical refund request is false.

production_outage.description: Does the message report that the production service is currently unavailable? Past resolved outages, staging/test failures, login problems for one user, and hypothetical outages are false.

phone_call_requested.description: Does the customer explicitly request a phone call or live telephone bridge? Email replies, past calls, and explicitly rejecting calls are false.

priority.description: urgent if there is a current production outage OR the customer explicitly requests action immediately/today, or states a deadline today. Otherwise normal. A negated urgency or hypothetical deadline does not count.

cases.context: Our receipt lists the wrong mailing address. Please send a revised copy by email at your convenience. The payment itself is correct.
I was billed for two licenses but ordered one. Please telephone me next week and return the payment for the unwanted license.
The bank needs proof of payment today. Email a paid invoice; no refund or phone conversation is required.
Call me today about the unexplained currency conversion fee. I want an explanation, not my money back.
Please reverse the subscription payment already taken after our cancellation. An email update next week is fine; the old request for an immediate call has been withdrawn.
The refund you sent has cleared. I would now like a phone conversation next month to reconcile the remaining invoices, with no further refund requested.
Email confirmation today that you have returned the duplicate shipping charge I paid. I am requesting that repayment now.
Please telephone our treasurer immediately and correct the company name on the invoice. The app is working and we are keeping the purchase.
In the sandbox, the chart legend covers the labels. Production works. Investigate next month and send the findings by email.
The attachment preview is upside down. Please schedule a telephone conversation next week to help reproduce this minor bug; there is no deadline.
Customers cannot reach our production service right now. We need it restored. Send written updates; our telephone bridge is not needed.
The live service is currently unavailable across all customer organizations. Please join a phone bridge to work on recovery.
My main request is to fix the broken spreadsheet export when convenient; normal production operations continue. Also refund the troubleshooting fee I paid. Please email me.
A production outage happened last year and is long resolved. Please phone me next month about the remaining visual glitch in the settings page.
Our production system is down for everyone at this moment. My main request is to restore it, and separately return the paid incident-response fee. Communicate by email.
The API is healthy but the desktop client cannot print. Fix the printing problem today and give me a telephone call.
Please email the procedure for moving my account login to a different address next month. I can sign in now; this is routine maintenance.
I need new recovery codes for my individual account. Please telephone me next week to guide me through the process. There is no urgency.
My personal password expired. Send reset instructions today by email; colleagues can access the service normally.
Ring me immediately to help recover my own account after I lost the security key. This is not a system-wide outage.
The main thing I need is to recover my forgotten username next week. Also reimburse the verification payment I already made. An email response is fine.
Please telephone me when convenient about changing the account recovery number. The earlier refund request was denied and I am not asking for it again.
Restore access to my individual login before a presentation today. Please email me; the voicemail saying to call back was from last week and no longer applies.
I mainly need the two-factor lock on my personal login removed today. Phone me to do that, and also reverse the support charge I already paid.
For a possible first purchase, please email documentation about your data export features next quarter. We have not paid anything.
We are exploring subscription options for next year. Telephone our team next month to compare plans and prices. No immediate response is necessary.
Email a quote today for our first purchase of twenty seats. A phone call would interrupt our meetings, so please do not call.
We need to choose a new vendor before the end of today. Please call with the price of your product; we are prospective customers.
If we purchased, we might later want a refund. We have paid nothing and only want an email explaining the cancellation terms next week.
Before subscribing for the first time, please telephone me next Tuesday about your uptime guarantees. I am asking about policy, not reporting a current outage.
Our purchasing deadline is today. Email a comparison of plan features immediately. We have no existing subscription or refund request.
Please ring my phone today to explain which plan includes audit exports before we buy. We have never paid for this product.
